consent.title: Your data, your choice
consent.body: JANSEVA stores the notices and reports you choose to save so it can remind you and track fixes. Aadhaar and phone numbers are hidden before any AI model sees your text. Photos are stored privately. You can delete your data at any time. (Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.)
